title: IPEDS FY2024 public degree-granting institution universe, 50 states
coverage: Every active degree-granting public institution in IPEDS HD2024 with CONTROL=1 and SECTOR=1 or 4 in the 50 states; District of Columbia and territories are outside the state-map boundary.
sourceCeiling: A no-separate-finance-record status means neither FY2024 Finance file publishes a UNITID row; the institution may report through a parent/system record. No amount is inferred or allocated.
